javax.microedition.theme
Interface ElementGroup

All Superinterfaces:
Element
public interface ElementGroup
extends Element

Represents a group of elements. A group consists of elements that are related and are treated as a unit, such as the parts of a highlight that consist of several bitmaps or other graphic items. All child elements in a group implicitly inherit the feature of their parent, but each of them has a different role.

Method Detail

equals

boolean equals(java.lang.Object otherElement)

Returns true if the two elements are both instances of ElementGroup, have the same feature, role and kind, and have the same number of elements, with equal content. In other words, to determine the equality of two element groups their elements (and all nested elements, if any) must be compared with their respective equals methods. If any comparison returns false, this method returns false.
